known_telemetry_and_engine_limitations.description: In kaggle_environments kaggriculture.py, crops deposited into the shed lose spatial/quadrant origin tags. Revenue attribution of strawberry and melon sales is therefore bounded by physical tile production limits rather than direct per-unit trade telemetry tags.
known_telemetry_and_engine_limitations.impact: Requires physical capacity upper-bounding and price schedule modeling rather than exact trade tracking.
known_telemetry_and_engine_limitations.remediation_status: Bound strictly verified by 40-unit physical limit.
